Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical factual error in the "Updated Understanding" section. It incorrectly identified Chian Hsiao-chang's father as Chiang Kai-shek. The WebSurfer results explicitly stated that Chiang Hsiao-chang is the daughter of Chiang Ching-kuo (who was the son of Chiang Kai-shek). By confusing the grandfather (Chiang Kai-shek) with the father (Chiang Ching-kuo), the Planner incorrectly concluded that the "other children" of the father were Chiang Ching-kuo and Chiang Wei-kuo (who are actually the children of Chiang Kai-shek, not Chiang Ching-kuo). Consequently, the final answer provided was factually incorrect regarding the specific relationship requested.
